name: Third Eye of Mental Exertion
body:
Aura strong clairsentience; ML 15th; Slot eyes; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

Manifesters who use this third eye find themselves spending more power points than usual to manifest their abilities. A third eye of mental exhaustion causes the wearer to spend an additional power point whenever he manifests a psionic power. Powers that identify psionic items incorrectly identify a third eye of mental exhaustion as a third eye of the Prodigy instead.
